entries.text: 就是啊，\n有點辛苦……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_01

entries.text: 丹瑜……妳有客人。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_steelbb_02

entries.text: 呵呵……\n真是個老實的好孩子！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_03

entries.text: 什麼嘛！太久沒見，\n讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳失憶了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_04

entries.text: 很高興能見到妳。\n再見。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_steelbb_04

entries.text: 那孩子是我的同學，\n是個超～有趣的女生。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_06

entries.text: 在藍莓學園看到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，\n總覺得有些神奇。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_08

entries.text: 仔細一看[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳……\n還真是都沒變呢！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_09

entries.text: 是因為最近我和\n白蕾雅老師一起去了\r\n很多地區調查的關係嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_10

entries.text: 比起以前我和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳交手的時候，\n我的寶可夢對戰變得更強了喔～[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_11

entries.text: 呵呵呵，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳當然想見識一下吧？\c\n既然這裡正好有對戰場，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就位吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_12

entries.text: 我們來場雙打對戰！\n做好心理準備了嗎？\r\n我會讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳嚇到呆的。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_13

entries.text: 唉～啊！\n我明明就透過太晶化變強了！\r\n但[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳比我還變得更強！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_14

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那手下不留情的地方，\n還真是一點都沒變呢！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_15

entries.text: 對了，話說回來，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和阿栗……見面了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_16

entries.text: 沒有！
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_01

entries.text: 怎麼了嗎？
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_02

entries.text: 啊，沒事……\n沒見面的話就好。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_17

entries.text: 怎麼會連這種事\n都做不到！！[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_01

entries.text: 果然是烏栗。\n真是陰錯陽差……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_27

entries.text: 烏栗！？
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_05

entries.text: 他變了個人！？
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_06

entries.text: 我說過至少要培育５隻\n比賽用的寶可夢吧？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_02

entries.text: 對、對不起，\n這個月忙著家裡的事……
entries.label: sdc02_0088_mob_01

entries.text: 那你就一輩子弱下去，\n怎麼樣？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_04

entries.text: 不、不，我……
entries.label: sdc02_0088_mob_02

entries.text: 你好像很忙，\n那我幫你寫吧。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_05

entries.text: 我的社團不需要\n拿不出全力的傢伙。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_brother_07

entries.text: 等等！烏栗！\n原諒我！求求你！
entries.label: sdc02_0088_mob_03

entries.text:
阿栗他的外表和性格
都有點……變了，
大概是在夏令營結束之後吧。
在那之後就好像……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_30

entries.text: 就～這麼撞見了\n叫人倒胃口的事啊。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_01

entries.text: 哎呀哎呀？是丹瑜……\n還有個沒看過的生面孔。\r\n……該不會[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她就是那個人吧？[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_02

entries.text: 傳聞中的問題人物。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_03

entries.text: 呿！被麻煩的\n傢伙給發現了。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_18

entries.text: 喂喂，\n好歹介紹一下啊。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_04

entries.text: ……他是杜若。\n是個討人厭的男生。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_19

entries.text: 他算是藍莓學園裡\n最強……曾經最強的傢伙。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_20

entries.text: 多謝介紹～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和烏栗！\n也是朋友吧～？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_06

entries.text: 是的
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_03

entries.text: 我們是朋友
entries.label: sdc02_0088_select_04

entries.text: 哦～\n果真是那樣啊！\r\n那真是太好了！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_07

entries.text: 那好，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n我帶[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳去參觀我們的社辦～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_08

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還沒參加社團吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_09

entries.text: 參加個社團，\n在學園也會更好過的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_10

entries.text: 我非常歡迎有趣的傢伙！\n……得先下手為強才行～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_11

entries.text: 把別人耍得團團轉的傢伙，太欠揍了～！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0088_sister_24
